A sheet is placed on a horizontal surface in front of a strong magnetic pole. A force is needed to: A.
hold the sheet there if it is magnetic. B. hold the sheet there if it is non-magnetic. C. move the sheet
away from the pole with uniform velocity if it is conducting. D. move the sheet away from the pole
with uniform velocity if it is both, non-conducting and non-polar. Choose the correct statement(s)
from the options given below:
(1)
B and D only
(2)
A and C only
(3)
A, C and D only
(4)
C only
Moving Charges and Magnetism

b4_script_options.4:
C only
Moving Charges and Magnetism

subject: Physics
b6_reason: A magnetic sheet is attracted so holding it needs force (A), and pulling a conducting sheet through the non-uniform field induces opposing eddy currents (C); non-magnetic, non-conducting non-polar sheets need none.
b6_working: A: magnetic sheet feels attraction towards the pole, so a force is needed to hold it in place - true. B: non-magnetic sheet feels no net magnetic force - false. C: conductor moving in a non-uniform field develops eddy currents whose force opposes the motion, so force is needed to keep uniform velocity - true. D: non-conducting and non-polar sheet has no induced currents or polarisation, so no force is needed - false. A and C only.
